title: To-dos
pick_hint: Pick a to-do on the left to see it
stage_pr_label: Open {pr} on {host} in a new tab
not_handed: Not handed to an agent yet
failed_agent_removed: Removed the agent that failed to start
auto_done: The agent stopped and judged this done, so it was marked done automatically. If it isn't, select Reopen.
auto_done_reason: The agent stopped and judged this done, so it was marked done automatically: {reason}. If it isn't, select Reopen.
notes_placeholder: Add notes; they go along as context when you hand this to an agent…
no_agents: Not handed to an agent yet. Use the button below to start.
no_agents_done: No agents on it now. Reopen it to hand it to an agent.
decisions_empty: Decisions made on this to-do go here. Your answers to an agent's questions are recorded automatically, and so are the outcome, decisions and pitfalls when a task is finished; you can add your own. The current ones go along when you hand it to an agent.
supersede_hint: The earlier choice "{choice}" stays, struck through; only the new one goes to agents.
question: Question
reason_placeholder: Why, and what was ruled out…
new_notes_placeholder: Details; they go along as context when you hand this to an agent…
sent: Sent and handed to the agent
no_live_agents: No available agents on online computers
prompt_placeholder: For example: fill in the network layer tests, covering retries and timeouts…
empty_body: Write down something to do, hand it to an agent and follow its progress.
unblock_other: waiting on others / CI / an environment
thread_unbind_confirm: Unbind the topic “{name}” from this to-do? Nothing in the topic is deleted. After this, the to-do's progress is no longer posted there, and replies there no longer reach this to-do.
thread_empty: No topic is bound to this to-do. Starting a topic in a group chat registered with /topics opens a new to-do and binds it; an Agent can also bind this to-do to a topic.
check_explanation: Assesses the task and its agents' latest replies and applies the result: the stage moves on from what the replies show, and work found finished moves on as a finished turn does. As evidence may change while checking, recheck when needed.
check_supervised: If this check finds the work complete, the task waits for its supervisor's review; the check does not close it.
check_wait: Checking… This can take up to a minute and a half.
check_skip_manual: This check read a manually created to-do. Automatic completion leaves those for you to close.
check_skip_done: This check read a task already marked complete. The assessment does not reopen tasks.
check_skip_reopened: This check found no new agent work after reopening, so automatic completion was excluded. Task status stays unchanged.
check_skip_unknown: Automatic completion was excluded for this check; the hub gave an unrecognized exclusion.
check_would_close: This check indicates the work qualifies for automatic completion. It has not marked the task complete.
check_would_not_close: This check does not indicate automatic completion.
check_applied_closed: Applied: the task is marked complete.
check_applied_review: Applied: the task now waits for its supervisor's review.
check_applied_kept: Applied: this verdict is kept on the task, which stays open.
check_unblock_unknown: Who can clear the blocker is not established.
check_timeout: The check took too long to respond. No assessment is available. You can try again.
check_unsupported: This hub does not support completion checks yet. Update the hub to use this action.
check_auth: Sign in again to check completion.
check_forbidden: Completion checks require full access. A read-only connection cannot run this check.
check_missing: This task could not be found. It may have been removed; refresh the task list.
check_model_error: The assessment could not be completed. The judgment service may be unavailable. Try again later.
check_unavailable: The task service is unavailable. Try again later.
check_network: Could not reach the hub. Check your connection and try again.
check_failed: Could not check completion. No assessment is available. Try again.
calendar_undated_one: {count} to-do has no due date and isn't on the calendar.
calendar_undated_other: {count} to-dos have no due date and aren't on the calendar.
ask_answer_hint: Nothing is recommended, so answer it in the conversation it came from.
ask_held_hint: This decision can wait, so nothing was pushed for it. It comes with your next briefing, and you can answer it here any time.
direction_unlisted_one: {count} more open to-do isn't under a pinned direction, such as a worker task under its lead's Agent. Group by Status to see every to-do.
direction_unlisted_other: {count} more open to-dos aren't under a pinned direction, such as worker tasks under their lead's Agent. Group by Status to see every to-do.
shelved_hint: No progress for 48 hours and nothing running. Not counted as open; nothing was deleted.
filter_hidden_waiting: {count} more waiting on you, not in {filter}
filter_empty_no_due: Every to-do has a due date
ask_chat_hint: Your next message answers this decision and is saved on the task. Cancel this address to discuss it without deciding.
